name: IOC Sea Level (global)
description: Real-time water-level observations from ~700 stations worldwide, run by the IOC Sea Level Station Monitoring Facility (UNESCO). Surfaces in the place panel for coastal places where no national prediction network is in range.

ioc-sealevel.purpose: Observed water level + 24 h curve for global places near an IOC station.
ioc-sealevel.dataReceived: Latest observed water level, 24 h observation curve, and derived high/low events.
